additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416174-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2/PD 312555359/19 ] The customer lost the communication with the Charger CRM:02684000032
additional_info.body:
Hello Fatima,
the error code 17 is a internal communication error
And the Mising converters symbolizes a faulty converter
17
Non-critical
N
Internal Communication Error
There may be a problem. A technician can check why there is no communication with the converter by inspecting the converter's HMI to see if it is powered. If the HMI has a black screen, a new converter is needed.
The converter with the serial number 2102312VGQKXN9000766 needs to be located in the charger and checked. Definitions of the groups and converters can be found in the manual.
@antoine Could you please arrange for a technician to visit this site? The Router XF4 is offline again, and I am unable to retrieve any data from it. The connection attempts are timing out, and the logs from the past few days show multiple offline sessions. It will be necessary to bring a new router to the site.
